LanguageData.DMS_Building_FPVNest.label: FPV nest
LanguageData.DMS_Building_FPVNest.description: An automated drone nest used for facility defense. When alerted by the facility's other sensors, it automatically launches FPV drones to drive off or kill intruders, and it will also release drones to fight back when attacked. It is connected to the facility's underground logistics system below, so its expended drone stock is automatically replenished over time.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_FPVHanger.label: FPV hangar
LanguageData.DMS_Building_FPVHanger.description: An automated drone hangar used for facility defense. When alerted by the facility's other sensors, it automatically launches FPV drones to drive off or kill intruders, and it will also release drones to fight back when attacked. It is connected to the facility's underground logistics system below, so its expended drone stock is automatically replenished over time.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Camera.label: camera
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Camera.description: A surveillance camera that monitors a long, narrow corridor for intruders. Connected to the local alert counter. Cut power or hit it with an EMP to disable it safely before dismantling.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Sensor.label: seismic sensor
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Sensor.description: A passive sensor installed along pipes and secondary passageways. The larger the thing entering its range, the more likely it is to trip the alarm.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Scanner_Large.label: large sentry tower
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Scanner_Large.description: A long-endurance self-sustaining unmanned sentry platform, fitted with multiple types of sensors to monitor a wide area for suspicious activity. Once alerted, it broadcasts an alarm signal that activates the surrounding automated defenses to engage.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Scanner_Small.label: small sentry tower
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Scanner_Small.description: An unmanned sentry platform built for long-term unattended operation, fitted with multiple types of sensors to monitor a wide area for suspicious activity. Once an intruder enters its range, it broadcasts an alert that activates the automated defenses to engage.
LanguageData.DMS_Hole_7x7Empty.label: facility opening
LanguageData.DMS_Hole_7x7Empty.description: A section of structural flooring with an open hole in it, commonly found in underground facilities.
LanguageData.DMS_Hole_5x5Empty.label: facility opening
LanguageData.DMS_Hole_5x5Empty.description: A section of structural flooring with an open hole in it, commonly found in underground facilities.

LanguageData.DMS_Hole_3x3Empty.description: A section of structural flooring with an open hole in it, commonly found in underground facilities.
LanguageData.DMS_Hole_3x5Empty.label: facility opening
LanguageData.DMS_Hole_3x5Empty.description: A section of structural flooring with an open hole in it, commonly found in underground facilities.
LanguageData.DMS_Hole_3x7Empty.label: facility opening
LanguageData.DMS_Hole_3x7Empty.description: A section of structural flooring with an open hole in it, commonly found in underground facilities.
LanguageData.DMS_Wreckage_Chunk.label: wreckage chunk
LanguageData.DMS_Wreckage_Chunk.description: A chunk of wreckage mangled beyond recognition. Strictly speaking, it makes decent cover. Tearing it down completely takes a while, but yields a small amount of metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Wreckage_SentryGun.label: disabled sentry gun
LanguageData.DMS_Wreckage_SentryGun.description: A badly damaged small sentry turret. Strictly speaking, it makes passable cover, and a small amount of metal scrap can be salvaged from it.
LanguageData.DMS_Wreckage_Ronin.label: disabled ronin
LanguageData.DMS_Wreckage_Ronin.description: A badly damaged Ronin automatroid. Strictly speaking, it makes passable cover, and a small amount of metal scrap can be salvaged from it.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_GatekeeperDestoryed.label: destroyed gatekeeper
LanguageData.DMS_Building_GatekeeperDestoryed.descrip: The burnt-out remains of a Gatekeeper close-in defense turret. Its rotary cannon has been torn apart and its fire-control systems gutted, leaving a hulk that still makes excellent cover. Tearing it down completely takes a while, but yields a small amount of metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_RadarDestoryed.label: destroyed radar
LanguageData.DMS_Building_RadarDestoryed.description: The wreck of an air-defense radar station. Its antenna array has been shredded and the emitter is long dead, leaving the surrounding airspace unwatched. The remaining mount makes decent cover. Tearing it down completely takes a while, but yields a small amount of metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_MissileLauncherDestoryed.de: The wreck of a missile launch platform. Its launch cells are scorched hollow, and any remaining ordnance was removed or destroyed long ago. The remaining frame makes decent cover. Tearing it down completely takes a while, but yields a small amount of metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_FPVHangerDestoryed.label: destroyed FPV hangar
LanguageData.DMS_Building_FPVHangerDestoryed.descript: A drone launch bay that has been utterly destroyed and can no longer launch drones. The remaining wreck makes decent cover. Tearing it down completely takes a while, but yields a small amount of metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_FPVNestDestoryed.label: destroyed FPV nest
LanguageData.DMS_Building_FPVNestDestoryed.descriptio: A drone launch nest that has been utterly destroyed and can no longer launch drones. The remaining wreck makes decent cover. Tearing it down completely takes a while, but yields a small amount of metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Machine_Medium.label: facility machine
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Machine_Medium.description: A machine of unknown purpose. Its internal components are intact and still running; breaking it down yields some resources.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Eletric_Medium.label: facility machine
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Eletric_Medium.description: A machine of unknown purpose. Its internal components are intact and still running; breaking it down yields some resources.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Machine_MediumDestoryed.des: A machine of unknown purpose. Its internal components rusted and failed long ago; breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Eletric_MediumDestoryed.des: A machine of unknown purpose. Its internal components rusted and failed long ago; breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Scanner_LargeDestoryed.desc: A large unmanned sentry platform that ceased functioning long ago. Its sensor array is completely destroyed, no longer able to detect intruders or broadcast alerts. The remaining tower structure makes decent cover. Tearing it down completely takes a while, but yields a small amount of metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_Scanner_SmallDestoryed.desc: A small unmanned sentry platform that ceased functioning long ago. Its sensors are completely destroyed, no longer able to detect intruders or broadcast alerts. The remaining wreck makes passable cover, and a small amount of metal scrap can be salvaged from it.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_VentSmall.label: active vent
LanguageData.DMS_Building_VentSmall.description: An active vent used for facility ventilation and NBC gas filtration. By keeping the facility under positive pressure, it prevents harmful gases from spreading through the facility's air circulation.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_VentMedium.label: active vent
LanguageData.DMS_Building_VentMedium.description: An active vent used for facility ventilation and NBC gas filtration. By keeping the facility under positive pressure, it prevents harmful gases from spreading through the facility's air circulation.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_VentLarge.label: active vent
LanguageData.DMS_Building_VentLarge.description: An active vent used for facility ventilation and NBC gas filtration. By keeping the facility under positive pressure, it prevents harmful gases from spreading through the facility's air circulation.

LanguageData.DMS_LogisticContainer.label: logistic container
LanguageData.DMS_LogisticContainer.description: A standard issue cargo container containing military logistics supplies.
LanguageData.DMS_LogisticTerminal.label: logistic terminal
LanguageData.DMS_LogisticTerminal.description: A logistics terminal linked to the cargo line below.
LanguageData.DMS_SubstationCabinet.label: substation cabinet
LanguageData.DMS_SubstationCabinet.description: A ruggedised metal cabinet that taps an underground power conduit and distributes electricity to surface equipment. The high-voltage internals make shut-down hazardous - only an operator with solid technical knowledge (Intellectual 8+) can safely cut power; anyone less experienced risks a serious electrical burn. An EMP strike will temporarily disable the cabinet without ongoing danger.
LanguageData.DMS_SubstationCabinet_Wall.label: wall substation panel
LanguageData.DMS_SubstationCabinet_Wall.description: A compact substation panel mounted flush against a wall, routing underground power to surface equipment. Like its cabinet counterpart, shutting it down safely requires real technical skill - anyone less experienced risks a severe electrical burn from the exposed high-voltage contacts. Vulnerable to EMP.
LanguageData.DMS_EmergencyLamp.label: emergency lighting
LanguageData.DMS_EmergencyLamp.description: An emergency lighting system that automatically switches to its internal battery only when grid power is lost, glowing red for extended periods to maintain a minimum level of illumination even during an outage.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_DoorLarge.label: heavy blast door
LanguageData.DMS_Building_DoorLarge.description: A reinforced heavy door built for military installations. It slides open along its track to let authorized personnel pass, and seals shut to block unauthorized intruders.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_DoorLarge_Mirrored.label: heavy blast door
LanguageData.DMS_Building_DoorLarge_Mirrored.descript: A reinforced heavy door built for military installations. It slides open along its track to let authorized personnel pass, and seals shut to block unauthorized intruders.
LanguageData.DMS_Building_DoorLarge_Damaged.label: ruined blast door
LanguageData.DMS_Building_DoorLarge_Damaged.descripti: The wreck of a heavy military blast door, jammed and burned out. It can no longer open or seal; it is nothing more than a structural remnant standing in the ruins.
The wreck of a heavy military blast door, jammed and burned out. It can no longer open or seal; it is nothing more than a structural remnant standing in the ruins.
LanguageData.DMS_RaidWaveBeacon_PeacekeepingOperators: A tampered emergency transponder repurposed to broadcast a false peacekeeping distress call. Once activated, it summons a Legacy remnant peacekeeping detachment - Protector shieldbearers screening a Ronin spearhead, with Falcon marksmen providing overwatch - to storm the signal's origin. The burst burns out the transmitter, so this building can only be used once.
LanguageData.DMS_TableArtifuscleDestroyed.label: ruined artifuscle chamber
LanguageData.DMS_TableArtifuscleDestroyed.description: The wreck of a high-end artifuscle cultivation chamber. Its growth vats have shattered and their contents rotted away long ago. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_TableMachinePrinterDestroyed.label: ruined machinery printer
LanguageData.DMS_TableMachinePrinterDestroyed.descrip: The wreck of a composite metal printer. Its forging rams are seized solid and the print bed is buried under collapsed tooling. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_LabReactorDestroyed.label: ruined lab reactor
LanguageData.DMS_LabReactorDestroyed.description: The wreck of an experimental reaction chamber. Its vessel has ruptured and whatever it once processed has crusted over the burst plumbing. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_LabFurnaceDestroyed.label: ruined lab furnace
LanguageData.DMS_LabFurnaceDestroyed.description: The wreck of an experimental sintering furnace, burnt out from the inside. Its heating elements are slagged and the chamber lining has collapsed. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_MachineCabinetDestroyed.label: ruined machine cabinet
LanguageData.DMS_MachineCabinetDestroyed.description: The wreck of a calibration cabinet. Its precision instruments have been smashed or stripped, leaving only a gutted shell. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_HoundBaseDestroyed.label: ruined hound station
LanguageData.DMS_HoundBaseDestroyed.description: The wreck of a hound unit charging station. Its docking cradle is empty and the charging contacts have corroded beyond repair. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_TrashBinBaseDestroyed.label: ruined trashpan station
LanguageData.DMS_TrashBinBaseDestroyed.description: The wreck of a trashpan unit charging station. Its docking cradle is empty and the charging contacts have corroded beyond repair. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_LogisticContainerDestroyed.label: ruined logistic container
LanguageData.DMS_LogisticContainerDestroyed.descripti: A breached military cargo container. Whatever supplies it once held were looted or destroyed long ago, leaving only the torn shell. Breaking it down yields some metal scrap.
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_Material.label: small material crate
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_Material.description: A small standard issue equipment crate containing supplies. The lid carries no colour band, so there is no telling what is inside until it is opened.
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_Parts.label: small component crate
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_Parts.description: A small standard issue supply crate. The blue band marks it as machine parts. Most hold ordinary components, though advanced ones turn up now and then.
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_SmallArms.label: small arms crate
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_SmallArms.description: A small standard issue supply crate. The red band marks it as weapons. Inside is a single small arm, still packed in factory grease.
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_Prosthetic.label: small prosthetics crate
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_Prosthetic.description: A small standard issue supply crate. The green band marks it as medical supplies. Most hold stamponents, though a bionic part turns up now and then.
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_Ration.label: small ration crate
LanguageData.DMS_CrateSmall_Ration.description: A small standard issue supply crate. The yellow band marks it as food. Inside are survival meals or combat rations.
LanguageData.DMS_DataCache_Restricted.label: restricted technical data cache
LanguageData.DMS_DataCache_Restricted.description: An encrypted record module holding a technical file that was never cleared for local circulation, kept by colonial army units as a reference for technical signatures. A colonist can spend a few hours decrypting it to reveal a restricted-class occultech research project and make a little progress on it.
LanguageData.DMS_DataCache_Sealed.label: sealed data cache
LanguageData.DMS_DataCache_Sealed.description: A record module with its seal intact. Files at this classification rarely leave the archives the fleets keep watch over. A colonist can decrypt it to reveal a sealed-class occultech research project and make some progress on it.
LanguageData.DMS_DataCache_Occulted.label: occulted data cache
LanguageData.DMS_DataCache_Occulted.description: An unmarked composite record module with no ports and no seams. A colonist can decrypt it to reveal an occulted-class occultech research project and make some progress on it.
